title: Binding conflict
description: A binding that names no account because another account holds what it would name (registry BINDING_CONFLICT): the name an unbound subject derives, the name a binding is recorded under, or a recorded number the app can hand out again. One shape wherever it travels: an apply or plan outcome's conflict, a BINDING_CONFLICT problem's extension member, and an entry of GET /subjects' conflicts. username and account_id are the HOLDER's, never the subject's account, and the holder is never acted on for the subject.

account_id.description: The holder's account_id, in the same read.

adoptable.description: account.adopt would bind the holder to this subject as things stand: no other subject holds it, it is not the add-on's own, and this subject has no binding.

bound_to.description: The subject the holder is bound to, when one is.

detail.description: What the conflict is, as a sentence for an operator, in the add-on's words.

next.description: What the operator does next, as a sentence.
